reason: Delivery decides it: C17 has 37 major episodes (P95) against C15's 21 (P47), and roughly 42 major PRs out of 144 against C15's 26 out of 243. They are durable, company-wide security changes: Content Security Policy taken from report-only to enforced and tightened to named hosts (#106238, #116719), one access-precedence resolver (#114423, deep-read P=16), SSRF connect-time pinning shared across warehouse sources (#95376, #101362), and eMudhra CA removal across every runtime within 3 days (#121580, #122294). C15 is the stronger team lever (trust_rank P84, cross_team 25 vs 18, 95 downstream authors) and his OAuth and MCP fixes (#113013, #105547) matter, but his higher delivery score comes from volume, his quality is weaker (quality_rate 0.945 vs 0.954, 7 follow-up fixes), and 83 PRs, including security majors, were approved by a single growth teammate; C17's main red flag, the CSP repair tail of about 24 PRs, was planned and closed by him.
